WITH actor_counts AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count
  FROM film f
  LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id
),
first_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count
  FROM actor_counts
),
first_pass AS (
  SELECT ac.film_id, ac.actor_count, ac.actor_count - fa.avg_count AS excess_first
  FROM actor_counts ac
  CROSS JOIN first_average fa
  WHERE fa.avg_count IS NOT NULL
    AND ac.actor_count > fa.avg_count
),
second_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count
  FROM first_pass
),
second_pass AS (
  SELECT fp.actor_count, fp.excess_first, fp.actor_count - sa.avg_count AS excess_second
  FROM first_pass fp
  CROSS JOIN second_average sa
  WHERE sa.avg_count IS NOT NULL
    AND fp.actor_count > sa.avg_count
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actor_count), 0) AS total_actor_count,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_average,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_average
FROM second_pass;
